itens.titulo: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Bounces, But Where Does It Go Next? Here’s What the Charts Say Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin is trading at $82,295, up 1.28% in 24 hours, after a Thursday slide below $80,000, its first dip under that level in more than a month.
Ethereum gained 4.17% to $2,473.17, Solana rose 3.02%, and XRP added 2.03%.
Zcash is the strongest of the top 15 largest coins, jumping 10.29% to $1,222.02, lifting its market cap to $20.67 billion, and roughly erasing the almost 10% it lost on Thursday.
Thursday's drop triggered $948 million in liquidations, 90.6% of them longs, per CoinGlass data.
On the daily chart, Bitcoin hugs an important resistance market of $81,603, a level traders draw between a major low and high to estimate where pullbacks find buyers.
Thursday's wick to $79,711 dipped under it and under the 50-day exponential moving average, or EMA, a line weighting recent prices more heavily, now at $80,407.
The 200-day EMA sits at $75,759, about 8% below the current price, and with the 50-day above it, the long-term trend still reads bullish.
The Average Directional Index, or ADX, which measures trend strength without direction, reads 25.5, barely above the 25 line that confirms a trend, and sellers (DI-) lead buyers (DI+).

itens.titulo: Meta expected to beat revenue forecasts as AI boosts advertising, says Bank of America
itens.descricao: Meta expected to beat revenue forecasts as AI boosts advertising, says Bank of America Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META, XETRA:FB2A, SIX:FB) is expected to beat third-quarter revenue forecasts as artificial intelligence (AI) supports advertising growth, Bank of America has said.
The bank forecasts revenue of $63.8 billion for the three months to September, above the $63.3 billion consensus estimate, and maintains a Buy rating with an $810 price target.
Meta is due to report results on 21 October, with investors focused on advertising trends, new AI products and the cost of expanding its computing infrastructure.
Bank of America expects earnings per share of $3.79, below the $6.08 consensus, after Meta records a one-off $10 billion legal settlement charge linked to state attorneys general.
For the fourth quarter, Bank of America forecasts revenue of $74.1 billion and earnings per share of $8.74, compared with consensus estimates of $73.6 billion and $8.18, respectively.
The bank expects Meta to guide for fourth-quarter revenue of between $71.5 billion and $74.5 billion, representing an annual growth of 19% to 24%, against 25% in the third quarter.
It also anticipates a narrower 2026 expense outlook, with the lower end potentially rising by $10 billion to $175 billion because of the settlement charge.
Bank of America expects Meta to narrow its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to between $140 billion and $145 billion, reflecting spending on data centres and other AI infrastructure.

itens.titulo: Will Intel (INTC) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
itens.descricao: Will Intel (INTC) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report? Yahoo Finance
trechos: The company has topped estimates by 1,450.00%, on average, in the last two quarters.
For the most recent quarter, Intel was expected to post earnings of $0.21 per share, but it reported $0.42 per share instead, representing a surprise of 100.00%.
For the previous quarter, the consensus estimate was $0.01 per share, while it actually produced $0.29 per share, a surprise of 2,800.00%.
Our research shows that stocks with the combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) or better produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time.
In other words, if you have 10 stocks with this combination, the number of stocks that beat the consensus estimate could be as high as seven.
Intel currently has an Earnings ESP of +1.11%, which suggests that analysts have recently become bullish on the company's earnings prospects.
This positive Earnings ESP when combined with the stock's Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) indicates that another beat is possibly around the corner.
We expect the company's next earnings report to be released on October 29, 2026.
